q: 2 years ago, average(A,B)=32. A will be 38 in 5 years. B is 5 years younger than C. Find the difference between A's and C's ages.
sol: A+B=68 (2 yrs ago avg), A now=33, B=35, C=40. |A-C|=7

sol: Siblings sum now=39+9=48. Family sum=48+82=130. Avg=130/5=26

q: A class of 30 boys has average age 15. A 20-year-old leaves and 2 new boys join (5 years apart); the average stays 15 for the now-31 boys. Find the younger new boy's age.
sol: New sum needed=465-430=35 for 2 boys, diff 5 → ages 15,20. Younger=15
